title: Routing and basing maritime patrol aircraft for fisheries surveillance around marine protected areas: code and results
description: Notebooks and results that reproduce the article Routing and basing maritime patrol aircraft for fisheries surveillance around marine protected areas: an out-of-sample evaluation with vessel-tracking data. The notebooks download apparent fishing effort from Global Fishing Watch (dataset public-global-fishing-effort:v4.0) and protected-area boundaries from the WDPA, build the cell and block grid, train the risk model, plan monthly sorties with the routing heuristic, compute the linear-programming bound and the exact benchmarks, run the out-of-sample backtest and the enumeration of deployments, and produce every table and figure of the article. Raw Global Fishing Watch data are not redistributed: the notebooks download them with the user's own API token.
